params.name: completedAtOrAfter
params.description:
Filter batches that were completed at or after the date time
provided. This can be used in combination with `completedAtOrBefore`.

params.name: completedAtOrBefore
params.description:
Filter batches that were completed at or before the date time
provided. This can be used in combination with `completedAtOrAfter`.

params.name: status
params.description:
Selects the payment batches that match the status provided. When left
unspecified, it is the same as if `all` was specified.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many items to return at one time (max 100) (default 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Which item to start from. See [Pagination](#section/Pagination) for more information.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the payment batch.

items.docs:
The batches returned may include payments and credits that could be rejected or voided. This is by design. If you are synchronizing with an ERP, discard the rejected and voided payments or credits on successful payment batches. When payments or credits are voided, this can happen for a variety of reasons, such as:
- The payment provider cannot process that payment due to an error. - The vendor attached to that payment is missing required information or is no longer valid. - A stop payment
